resources.string: Factory apps language
Settings, Vehicle settings, phone, media and other 32-bit factory apps

These factory apps run as 32-bit processes that the translation agent cannot attach to. Controls translates them with resource overlays in /vendor/overlay instead. A new language applies after one restart; switching single apps or turning everything off works at once.
